description: The face of Coldwater Clone Facility.

flags.intro_lore: So this is the world. The Clone Facility door sighs shut behind you and Coldwater doesn't greet you so much as fail to notice — grey sky, loose stone crunching underfoot, a dead streetlight leaning at the verge like it gave up mid-thought. This is Ironside Street, the spine of this end of the basin: dust and old oil, storm drains levered open onto the dark of the Under, gun shops and pawn windows and clinics that charge you by the wound. Follow it southeast and the lights get warmer — the Embassy Hotel & Bar, where the basin comes to drink, deal, and be seen not dying for a while. It's the closest thing to a hearth Ironside offers, and like everything else out here it'll take your credits and remember your face. Whether that door means shelter or a mark is entirely up to how you carry yourself through it.

name: Coldwater Clone Facility
